Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates widening of the mediastinum with lateral displacement of both paraspinal lines, a finding characteristic of a posterior mediastinal mass. In the context of the provided options, this radiographic appearance is most consistent with lymphoma (often presenting as an anterior/middle mediastinal mass that can widen the silhouette), and among the choices, it is the only one correctly identifying bilateral paraspinal line displacement due to a mass.
